mission: Build real proof in AI, automation, and cybersecurity over 12 weeks through shipped projects, honest execution tracking, and internship-focused packaging.
identity: B.Tech CSE (Cybersecurity) student building AI tools, automation systems, and security-aware applications.

phases.title: Foundation and Execution Discipline
phases.goal: Build the execution system, ship the first security-aware AI tool, and create a stable working rhythm.

phases.title: Flagship Project Buildout
phases.goal: Turn PromptShield into a real flagship project that is structured, explainable, and internship-grade.

phases.title: Packaging, Outreach, and Conversion
phases.goal: Package the work, apply to roles, improve outreach, and close the sprint with proof and clarity.

weeks.goal: Ship the first working version of LIFE SAVER.
success_definition: LIFE SAVER runs locally.
SQLite is connected.
Daily check-in works.
Weekly roadmap page is visible.
Mission and week data are entered.
rules: Tutorial time max 45 minutes per day.

success_definition: PromptShield runs locally.
The app accepts risky text or prompts.
The app returns risk score, verdict, and matched patterns.
At least 10 sample inputs produce different outputs.
The whole week is logged in LIFE SAVER.
rules: Tutorial time max 45 minutes per day.
Use LIFE SAVER daily before ending the day.
No switching to a new stack.
No LangChain, no agents, no vector database.
This week is about working logic, not pretty UI.

weeks.goal: Add AI-assisted explanation, redaction, and scan history.
success_definition: Rule-based and AI-assisted reasoning both work.
Sensitive content is redacted before model analysis.
Scan history persists.
Results show score, categories, why, action, and safer guidance.
Five or six meaningful cases can be demoed cleanly.
rules: Tutorial time max 45 minutes per day.
No vector database, agents, or auth.

weeks.goal: Stabilize LIFE SAVER and PromptShield and improve public positioning.
success_definition: LIFE SAVER is usable every day without friction.
PromptShield can be demoed in three to five minutes.
GitHub profile clearly reflects AI + automation + cybersecurity.
First resume draft exists.
Month one progress is visible from the outside.
rules: Optimize for clarity, stability, and presentation.

weeks.goal: Turn PromptShield into a usable security console with persistence and review flow.
success_definition: Text can be scanned through UI or API.
Saved scans appear in a queue.
Detail view explains how a verdict was reached.
Analyst review states can be updated.
The system can be explained like a mini security tool.

weeks.goal: Expand PromptShield to more realistic input types.
success_definition: PromptShield supports at least two input modes.
Email-style content is analyzed differently from generic prompts.
Input mode is stored and shown in results.
File or large-text input works for simple cases.
The product demonstrates a more practical use case than Week 5.
rules: No PDF parser unless extremely lightweight.

weeks.goal: Make PromptShield feel like a mini analyst workstation.
success_definition: Overview dashboard shows real summary metrics.
Analyst notes are richer than a simple status.
Incident reports can be exported.
Score tuning is configurable and explainable.
Failure handling is stronger.
rules: Prefer HTML, Markdown, or JSON export over complex formats.
Every day must end with evidence in LIFE SAVER.

success_definition: PromptShield works end to end.
README, architecture story, and demo flow are clear.
The project can sit at the top of the resume.
Limitations and future improvements are documented.
GitHub and resume use PromptShield as flagship proof.
rules: No new large features unless they are tiny and clearly useful.
Focus on packaging, clarity, and credibility.

weeks.goal: Turn projects into internship-ready public proof.
success_definition: Resume v2 exists.
GitHub profile is clearer.
A simple portfolio or proof page exists.
LIFE SAVER tracks internship actions.
First targeted application batch is sent.
rules: Every application must be at least somewhat targeted.

weeks.theme: Build a lightweight support automation tool
weeks.goal: Ship Internship Copilot Lite to support real internship applications.
success_definition: The tool accepts a job description and fixed candidate profile.
It returns role fit, missing gaps, best project to highlight, and a tailored intro.
The tool is used on at least three real roles.
It supports actual applications without derailing PromptShield or LIFE SAVER.
rules: Build only a small support tool.

weeks.goal: Improve role targeting, outreach quality, and interview readiness.
success_definition: Role buckets are defined.
Message templates exist.
PromptShield and LIFE SAVER can be explained clearly in interview style.
Another meaningful application batch is sent.
Last major weak spots are identified and improved.
rules: Only small fixes on existing projects if they help interviews and applications.
Prioritize clarity, messaging, and consistent outreach.

weeks.theme: Finish the sprint like a professional
weeks.goal: Close the 12-week sprint with visible proof and a clear next step.
success_definition: Core assets are polished enough to share confidently.
Full 12-week review is complete.
Final application batch is sent.
Next 30-day continuation plan is defined.
Final identity and direction are clear.
rules: No overthinking what should have happened.
deliverables: Final resume and public profile package
